verdict.rationale: Floot's own platform docs list scheduled jobs as a built-in capability: "Jobs that run on a schedule, without a server to keep alive." That implies recurring execution rather than a one-off action. This is the only mention, and nothing describes how schedules are defined, managed or monitored, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of schedule configuration (cron/interval syntax), creating or managing schedules via the AI/MCP tools, run history or failure handling for scheduled jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Jobs that run on a schedule, without a server to keep alive.
